intended_object: The identity morphism of a right C-comodule M over a coalgebra C over a commutative semiring R, i.e. id_M viewed as a comodule homomorphism (C-colinear map) M → M. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: `RightComoduleHom X Y` is an R-linear map f : M → N satisfying ρ_Y ∘ f = (f ⊗ id_C) ∘ ρ_X, which is the standard definition of a comodule morphism. The definition takes the underlying map to be `LinearMap.id`. It satisfies the condition because `rTensor C id = id`. This is exactly the identity comodule morphism. The setting (a commutative semiring R and a coalgebra C) is the natural one. I found no comodule-morphism structure in this Mathlib version, so there is no counterpart to cite.
